metadata.basis: current compiler bootstrap with an exact updated main pin

reproduction.instructions: With .bootstrap/revision set to 4f9e1224e7f3cdb67fa4687d8f496717da1354aa and mncs-language.lock.json set to 843c5bcca7476bb6600218f6410a3da7ef5d96d5, run bash tools/bootstrap.sh; it exits 1 before build.

summary: After updating the compiler lock to the merged current Stage-0 commit, the existing marked .bootstrap tree still carried the former revision and tools/bootstrap.sh exited 1 before either Rust build, with no actionable diagnostic. The manual workaround would be to relocate or delete the generated tree.

workaround.description: Manual move/removal of the generated .bootstrap tree before rerunning the bootstrap.
